title: SCHC ACK transition discards detached receipt snapshot and parses caller-mutated RxFrame
description: Security review: LinkLayer.consume_verified_receipt returns a detached immutable snapshot, but the SCHC receipt callback discards it and FragmentSender parses signer/counter/payload from the caller-visible exact RxFrame. object.__setattr__ can mutate that object while retaining its registered receipt, causing authenticated semantic substitution. Return/use the detached snapshot under the same security lock for every ACK field and add payload/signer/epoch/seqnum mutation regressions.
